runs: gci3_C on g83 and g47 at alpha 0 and 4, all four gate-ACCEPTED
headline: The base term is no longer significant. It was 19-28 % of pressure drag at gci_C and is now 2.1-3.8 %, a thirteenfold reduction in absolute counts.

the_split_is_not_what_i_predicted.predicted: The opening ladder at gci_C measured -15.0 counts of CDp for 0.500 % -> 0.200 %, and I carried that number into the family 3 proposal.
the_split_is_not_what_i_predicted.measured: From gci2_C the same opening change gives -7.7 to -8.6 counts of CDp and -4.7 to -5.3 counts of base drag.
the_split_is_not_what_i_predicted.why: The two fixes are NOT additive. n_base does most of the work and the opening change then has much less left to take. Splitting the 22.4 -> 1.7 count fall on g83 a0: n_base 4 -> 8 cells accounts for -15.9 counts and the opening for the remaining -4.7. Roughly 77 % of the win came from the fix that was already free in family 2.
the_split_is_not_what_i_predicted.correction: My estimate of what family 3 would buy over family 2 was about twice the truth. The ladder measured the opening on a BADLY RESOLVED base, where it had more to remove.

cost_of_the_geometry_change.reading: C_L moves by 11-30 counts and changes sign between incidences, because the opening is made by adding thickness scaled by x/c, which acts like aft camber. Removing it reduces |C_L|. These are different wings and nothing may compare them to family 1 or 2 as the same design.
cost_of_the_geometry_change.CDv_shift: -0.24 to -0.28 counts, a slightly smaller wetted area.

the_decision_this_leaves.question: Is the geometry change worth keeping, now that its marginal value is measured?
the_decision_this_leaves.for: It takes the slowest-converging term in the study (p = 0.52) from 7.8 % of pressure drag to 2.3 %, and 0.200 % of chord is closer to ordinary CFD practice than 0.500 %.
the_decision_this_leaves.against: It buys about 8 counts of CDp over family 2, and costs comparability with 52 existing run directories. Family 2 alone already reduces the base term to 7-12 % of CDp using a change that is purely mesh and fully comparable.
the_decision_this_leaves.what_would_settle_it: The real wing's trailing-edge thickness. It is recorded nowhere in this repository. If the true TE is near 0.2 % of chord, family 3 is the more faithful model and the comparability cost is worth paying. If it is nearer 0.5 %, family 2 is already right and family 3 is a fiction.

meshes_built_and_verified: gci3_C/M/F/FF on g83 and g47, 1,059,152 to 8,066,928 cells, all with 0 folded cells, wall layer 1-2e-16, cap 2.04-2.07 x s0
